news_intelligence.title: Bright Outdoor Media moves to BSE, NSE main boards, eyes expansion
news_intelligence.summary:

The transition gives the Mumbai-based company a wider capital-market platform as it looks to expand its outdoor advertising network, increase its digital billboard portfolio and pursue opportunities in government and infrastructure-led projects, according to a company statement. Its business spans traditional outdoor advertising, digital displays and advertising contracts across public infrastructure and transit networks. The company said its expansion has included opportunities linked to the Navi Mumbai Metro Line advertising tender and the Vile Parle-Kandivali railway road overbridge advertising
